Your text. Your research.

One workspace.
Your perspective.

Find the passage that changes a chapter’s rhythm. Follow a scene detail back to its source. Share a reading copy with the background your readers need. Lixity brings close reading, research and language analysis into one local manuscript workspace.

Meet Lixity ↓

Fictional English manuscript. Read-only demo. No account or upload.

A connected writing workflow.

Close reading, evidence and chapter comparisons stay connected to the text. Built-in analysis runs offline; optional speech and research services are configured separately. The CLI and Python API reuse the same analysis engine.

Writing in Lixity: the integrated editor is implemented in the development checkout, not yet released. The tour and public demo show the read-only workflow.

Develop the text. Return to the passage.

Read without analysis marks, find a passage and leave work markers. The unreleased editor adds writing, undo and local autosave; switch to reading the saved revision without losing editor history.

Editor scope and availability (English)

See what makes a chapter different.

Compare sentence rhythm, vocabulary and readability across chapters. Open the counted words and sentences behind a measurement, then return to the passage. Export JSON with explicit settings for repeatable linguistic analysis.

Text-analysis workflow (English)

Keep the source behind the scene.

Connect a manuscript quotation to sources, dossiers and author decisions. Retained versions let you revisit the evidence behind a detail, even when a source or your interpretation changes.

Take a short tour

Give readers the right copy.

Prepare a PDF, a review workspace or a reading copy with selected background notes. Your source project stays yours.

Reading copy (English)
“

Measurements inform. You interpret.

Use patterns to ask better questions about a text. Counts describe the supplied material; heuristics need context. Lixity does not grade literary quality, prove authorship or rewrite your prose.

Bring your own text.

Install Lixity locally on Windows, macOS or Linux. Start with Markdown or plain text and follow the installation guide.

Installation guide (English)
uv tool install --python 3.12 --managed-python lixity

This website follows the development checkout. Check the published release for available features; optional services have separate data boundaries.

Published releases · v0.8.0 release notes

Seven languages. One workspace.

Explore this website in seven languages. The app follows the selected analysis profile; CLI report language has its own setting. Technical documentation stays in English.

Website measurement (English)

This public website uses GoatCounter to count page visits and named demo, installation, repository and PDF links. The adapter sends public page paths and event names, excluding query strings, fragments, form contents and manuscript selections. The local app and exported manuscript reports contain no such measurement.

Language and appearance choices are stored locally in this browser when storage is available. Browser language is used only to suggest a public introduction; it is not sent to a translation service or used to change manuscript analysis.

Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control disable collection. Counts are approximate and do not establish installations or active authors. GoatCounter receives technical request data; see its privacy information. For questions, use the contact below.
